caption: The drawing depicts a single large, cylindrical stoneware crock with a slightly flared rim and a small molded handle on its visible side. The crock is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with subtle shading suggesting its curvature and three-dimensional form. The interior of the open top appears dark, indicating depth. There is blue text inscribed near the upper edge of the crock that reads "E. NORTON & CO BENNINGTON VT" along with "1 1/2" below the inscription, denoting its capacity. The crock sits on a plain, neutral background with no additional objects or details in the composition.
title: Crock
